page-0.title: About Me
page-0.description:
🖈 Mumbai, Maharashtra
I'm Carlton Lobo, I am a B.Tech student in Electronics and Electrical Engineering at IIT Guwahati, and a electronics VLSI enthusiast.

page-1.title: Two Stage OTA
page-1.description:
Designed a 180 nm Two Stage Miller Compensated OTA with NMOS input Differential Pair, with a Current Mirror Load.
Second stage was a PMOS common source amplifier. An Ideal Current Source was used as the biasing circuit of Current in Tail / 10 to reduce power consumption.
The design had an Open Loop Gain of 69 dB, a Unity Gain Bandwidth of 27 MHz and a Phase Margin of 87 degrees, Slew Rate of 8.6 V/μs, CMRR of 87 dB while consuming 500μW.
page-1.alt: Image of the OTA design in LTspice

page-2.title: Digital Decimation Filters
page-2.description:
Designed various filters in MATLAB and implemented them in Verilog.
Filters like CIC, Cascaded Half Band, FIR and IIR were designed and implemented. The filters were designed to be used in a decimation process for a Sigma Delta ADC.
The filters were designed to have a cutoff frequency of Pi/2048, with an output of 20-Bits at 20 kSPS.
page-2.alt: Image of the filters designed in MATLAB and implemented in Verilog

page-3.title: RISC-V pipelined processor
page-3.description: Designed a 5 stage pipelined RISC-V processor in Verilog. The processor was designed to support the RV32I instruction set and had a clock frequency of 100 MHz and was verified with various testbenches.

page-4.title: Retro Game Console
page-4.description: Implemented Retro games like Snake and Pong on Verilog and then implemented them on an FPGA. The games were implemented using a VGA display and a FPGA buttons as input. The games were implemented using a state machine and a pixel generator to generate the graphics on the VGA display.
page-4.alt: Image of a Snake Game implemented on an FPGA

page-5.title: Hardware Image Processing
page-5.description:
Implemented various image processing algorithms like Edge Detection, Blurring and Sharpening on an FPGA. The algorithms used a pipelined line buffer system to store the pixel data and perform a 3x3 convolution on the pixel data to generate the output image.
The algorithms were performed on a live video feed from an OV7670 camera module and the output was displayed on a VGA display.
page-5.alt: Image of Edge Detection algorithm implemented on an FPGA

page-6.title: Precision Oscillator
page-6.description:
Designed a VCO using an Integrator, a Schmitt Trigger and a BJT current switcher.
A F-2-V Sensor was created using a differentiator and a Peak Detector to measure the frequency of the VCO output and then passed on an Active PID block. The PID ensured accrate frequencies even with changes in the magnitude of generated Triangular wave.
 The design was implemented on a perforated board and the results were verified with an oscilloscope.
page-6.alt: Image of the output of the Precision Oscillator

page-7.title: ALFR and Manipulator Robots
page-7.description:
A Line Follower Bot implemented using PID Control and a Manipulator Bot with 3 DOF was created from scratch using 3D printed parts.
The bots were created for the competition LAM Research Challenge 2025 and were designed to perform various tasks like picking and placing objects, following a line and avoiding obstacles. The bots were controlled using an Arduino and the code was written in C++.
page-7.alt: Image taken during the LAM Research Challenge 2025 of the ALFB and Manipulator Robots

page-8.title: Warehouse Management System
page-8.description: Uses ROS 2 to manage multiple robots to create a SLAM map of a warehouse and then use the map to navigate the robots to perform various tasks like navigating to specific locations. The system was designed to be scalable and can be used to manage a large number of robots in a warehouse environment.
page-8.alt: Image of the SLAM map generated by the Warehouse Management System

page-10.title: Lost in the Ether
page-10.description: A game in which you(an astronaut) crash land on a planet. You only have a rover which you can use to collect materials to repair you rocket ship to travel further in space in humanity's quest to find a habitable planet
